text.p: Tallinna Pank's syndicated loan for 30 million marks has been oversubscribed by investors, the bank said on Tuesday.

The closing date for subscriptions for the loan was Wednesday and the bank will decide tomorrow whether it will increase the syndicated loan sum, Guido Klaas, corporate finance department head, told Reuters.
"At the present time, the sum is considerably oversubscribed," Klaas said.
He did not say by how much the loan was oversubscribed as three banks have still to submit their offer on Wednesday.
Tallinna Pank earlier said its loan interest rate is LIBOR plus 1.375 percent with a three-year maturity.
Commerzbank AG and Vereins- und Westbank AG are leading the loan and began subscriptions on April 2.
